changeSet.author: kabipay-dev
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE "${schema}".organization_membership_installation ( tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, membership_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHING','DETACHED')), desired_status text NOT NULL CHECK(desired_status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHING')), version bigint NOT NULL CHECK(version>0), configuration_hash char(64) NOT NULL CHECK(configuration_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), retirement_transaction_id bigint, installed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,membership_id), UNIQUE(tenant_id,organization_id), CHECK((desired_status='DETACHING' AND status='DETACHED' AND retirement_transaction_id IS NOT NULL) OR (desired_status=status AND status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED'))) ); CREATE TABLE "${schema}".organization_membership_lifecycle_receipt ( tenant_id uuid NOT NULL, command_id uuid NOT NULL, membership_id uuid NOT NULL, organization_id uuid NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL CHECK(version>0), desired_status text NOT NULL CHECK(desired_status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHING')), status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHED')), configuration_hash char(64) NOT NULL CHECK(configuration_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'), drained_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,command_id), FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id,membership_id) REFERENCES "${schema}".organization_membership_installation(tenant_id,membership_id) ); ALTER TABLE "${schema}".organization_grant_installation ADD COLUMN status text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE' CHECK(status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','REVOKED')); ALTER TABLE "${schema}".organization_fact_bootstrap DROP CONSTRAINT organization_fact_bootstrap_status_check; ALTER TABLE "${schema}".organization_fact_bootstrap ADD CONSTRAINT organization_fact_bootstrap_status_check CHECK(status IN ('PENDING','COMPLETE','PAUSED','STOPPED'));
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "${schema}".organization_membership_active(company uuid,org uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $active$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".organization_membership_installation m WHERE m.tenant_id=company AND m.organization_id=org AND m.status='ACTIVE') $active$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "${schema}".organization_reporting_owned(company uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $owned$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".organization_membership_installation m WHERE m.tenant_id=company AND m.status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHING')) $owned$; CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "${schema}".organization_reporting_retirement_allowed(company uuid) RETURNS boolean LANGUAGE sql STABLE SET search_path=pg_catalog AS $retire$ SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".organization_membership_installation m WHERE m.tenant_id=company AND m.status='DETACHED' AND m.desired_status='DETACHING' AND m.retirement_transaction_id=txid_current() AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "${schema}".organization_membership_installation other WHERE other.tenant_id=company AND other.membership_id<>m.membership_id AND other.status IN ('ACTIVE','SUSPENDED','DETACHING')) AND current_setting('kabipay.organization_retirement',true)=m.tenant_id::text||':'||m.organization_id::text||':'||m.membership_id::text) $retire$; COMMENT ON TABLE "${schema}".organization_membership_lifecycle_receipt IS 'Permanent minimal source drain/installation receipt; original actor authorization remains in organization_command_receipt. Never cleanup as transport history.';
